top_categories.workout_context: 970 miles. Your legs will beg to quit after 120. This trains the power output you need from mile 130 onward.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Ride Across Britain's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before September.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 970 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

Road-specific control matters at Ride Across Britain. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 970 miles.
970 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Ride Across Britain's mixed terrain actually does to you.
Ride Across Britain's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At Ride Across Britain, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Ride Across Britain. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

race_overlay.nutrition: For a multi-day 970-mile race, no single calorie total or one-food strategy is credible. Rehearse continuous intake while riding plus substantial meals at planned stops; document carbohydrate, fluid, and sodium intake, resupply cadence, and gut response. Use checkpoints and publicly available services only as the category rules allow, carry backup calories, and complete a full night-riding systems rehearsal.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Ride Across Britain. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 970 miles of mixed terrain in Land's End to John O'Groats, UK.
